title: Raf
scene: 1984 Italian Italo-disco; Carrère; Milan studio and Anglo-influenced new wave background
notes: English-language Italo-disco blends insistent dance pulses with a rock guitar hook and edgy vocals.

title: Svegliarsi un anno fa
scene: 1988 Italian melodic pop-rock; CGD; Empoli studio musicians and Sanremo
notes: First Italian-language album combines guitar-led pop, brass passages and socially observant writing.

title: Cosa resterà...
scene: 1989 Italian electronic-pop and dance-pop; CGD; Empoli Central Park/Milan Morning Studio
notes: Programming and live guitars frame Ti pretendo and the reflective title song.

title: Sogni... è tutto quello che c'è
scene: 1991 Italian mainstream melodic pop with electronic arrangements; CGD; Milan Morning Studio
notes: Reflective romantic pop balances programmed textures, strong ballads and the Eros Ramazzotti duet.
